test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 23 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT correct?

options.text: The angle of incidence and refraction are equal.
The incident ray, refracted ray and normal to the surface at incidence lie in the same plane.
The speed of light in different media is different.
The speed of light in the given medium is different for different colours,

solution:
The correct answer is __**The angle of incidence and refraction are equal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The angle of incidence and refraction are not equal unless the light travels in the same medium (when both angles are 0 degrees).
 
• The angles only become equal in the case of normal incidence, where the ray strikes perpendicular to the surface.
 
• **The incident ray, refracted ray and normal to the surface at incidence lie in the same plane**. This statement is **correct**.
 
 
• This is a fundamental law of refraction.
 
 
 
• **The speed of light in different media is different**. This statement is **correct**.
 
 
• The speed of light changes as it passes from one medium to another due to the change in the medium's refractive index.
 
 
 
• **The speed of light in the given medium is different for different colours**. This statement is **correct**.
 
 
• This is called dispersion. The refractive index of a medium varies slightly with the wavelength (color) of light, causing different colors to travel at slightly different speeds.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The following are the laws of refraction of light.
 
 
• The incident ray, the refracted ray and the normal to the interface of two transparent media at the point of incidence, all lie in the same plane.
 
• The ratio of sine of angle of incidence to the sine of angle of refraction is a constant, for the light of a given colour and for the given pair of media. This law is also known as **Snell’s law of refraction**. (This is true for angle 0 (sin i)/(sin r)=constant
